scripts.docs: vp run --filter '@kvirn/docs^...' build && vp run --parallel --filter @kvirn/docs --filter @kvirn/core --filter @kvirn/i18n --filter @kvirn/ui --filter @kvirn/theme dev
scripts.test: vp test run --project node --project browser && node tooling/storybook-run/storybook-run.ts storybook
scripts.sweep: node tooling/storybook-run/storybook-run.ts storybook-forced-colors storybook-reduced-motion storybook-reflow storybook-text-spacing
scripts.ci: vp fmt --check && vp run build && vp lint && pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run i18n:check && pnpm run theme:check && pnpm run sweep
